scope: One fixed fit on the frozen 46 pairs and S2 anchor stream using the trapezoid transition. Change only the velocity half-difference response lead weights. Preserve the absolute state term and the position and spin response terms.
weight_normalization: Scale the replacement velocity weights to the original velocity mass after applying pair weights and the binary replay-noise eligibility mask, before the shared response normalization. Preserve per-component weights and existing resolved or unresolved response treatment.

evaluation.held_timing: Use frozen validation_lateral tick-168 branches. Require short-pulse H32 position JVP and finite secant agreement and both to pass for at least one of reversal or dual axis. Require H32 nominal position error <=1.10 times the original 46-pair non-trapezoid endpoint. Report H1/H8/H16/H24/H32 position, velocity and spin, and improvements versus the matched trapezoid endpoint.
evaluation.legacy_protection: Require 22 protections against the 40-pair reference. Report the 22 checks against the original and trapezoid 46-pair references separately. Report history_validation_yminus006_advance tick 72 held roll by identity. Report velocity half-difference results as development evidence.

stop_conditions: Frozen source, evidence, data or anchor identity mismatch
Failed branch mask, weight or gradient preflight
Nonfinite loss, gradient or model; resource or time cap
900-update endpoint and development evaluation complete; no automatic rerun or checkpoint selection
